speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Gamekeeper's thumb (Stener lesion) or similar ligamentous injury of the fifth digit (ring finger) due to forced abduction/rotation.

I am Dr. Agent. The mechanism of injury—your finger being caught and forcefully pulled while playing football—strongly suggests a ligamentous injury. Can you tell me if you felt a loud "pop" or snap at the moment of injury, and if there is any visible deformity or bruising now? REQUEST IMAGES: X-Ray right hand. REQUEST TEST: MRI right hand.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
